description:
An Open Conversation with Andrew Lih, Peter B. Kaufman, and Curt Newton


MIT Open Learning’s Curt Newton, Peter B. Kaufman, and Wikimedian Andrew Lih discuss this new collaboration with Wikipedia on trustworthy publicly available knowledge. 

Andrew Lih brings deep expertise in open knowledge and cultural heritage collaborations. Serving as Wikimedian at Large for the Smithsonian Institution, he helped spearhead the Smithsonian’s landmark 2020 Open Access initiative, which released millions of digital assets from its museums, libraries, archives, and zoo for public use. His previous work includes serving as Wikimedia Strategist at The Metropolitan Museum of Art and leading projects with the U.S. National Archives that expanded access to archival content through Wikimedia platforms.
